text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, I look outside to see
piles of
snow. The temperature must
have dropped
suddenly last night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The snow on the track has already been
plowed,
though, so training shouldn't be
an issue.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're already here.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm not running!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna run! No way! I don't feel
like it one
bit!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes a peek at me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nope!

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer
text_block_list.text:
What are they doing over there on the
side of the
track?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That trainer's getting pushed
around by
their trainee. It looks like
she's having another
tantrum.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! And the snow's only going to
get
heavier... What if she catches a cold?

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm pretty worried too. She's still
pretty
young.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho is standing next to me,
breathing on
her hands to try and stay
warm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She already got changed and came all
the way
here. She'd definitely warm up
faster if she just
started running.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What're you staring at me for?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna say something, just say it.
That's
what all the other adults do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tell me to run for my future, or to go
home if I
don't feel like running, or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she really didn't want to run, I don't
think she
would have shown up for
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she makes the effort to come to
every single
training session... I really
have no reason to doubt
her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snow starts to fall while I wait for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I brush the snowflakes off my shoulders,
and the
damp spots they leave on my
clothes slowly grow
wider.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The snowfall thickens and eases over
time, but
continues nonetheless. I sit
beside Sweep Tosho
on the track in
weather just as moody as she is.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run! Time me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Accelerating with minimal effort, she
cuts right
through the cold air.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear others chattering all around me
and realize
I'm not the only one
captivated by Sweep Tosho's
running.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Pant... Phewww!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanna find that racing magic! And
that's why I
wanna run in a big race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I know what to do! You don't have to
tell me! It's
not like my head's totally
empty!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I'm so sick of everyone telling me
what to do
and acting like they're so
much smarter than me...
It makes me so
mad!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's really not what I want from them.
Even if
they just say it's all for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I just see red when I hear someone say it.
Even
though I should be focused on my
race, I get so
wound up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But you, Familiar...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're the only one who speaks to me
like you
did earlier. Like asking if I had a
reason.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Just believe in me. Listen to what I think.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't try and force me to do what you
think's
right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Duh. I wanna find that racing magic!
That's why I
work so hard every day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At some point while I watch her train,
the snow
stops.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, Familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, I was just checking to make sure
you
weren't lying when you said you
believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And, well... I guess you passed, so I'll
cast a
special spell on you as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Twinkle Twinkle ☆ Rank up, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I guess that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I leveled up your familiar ranking! Now
you're just
a teeeensy bit cooler than
before!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Also, that spell made you more special
than the
other familiars. You're special
enough now that I
can ask you for
advice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right. So listen up.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wanna run in the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma told me that my great grandma used magic in that race!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in a book too! It said that a great
witch
who was friends with a great fairy
wore a tiara!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you look so confused for,
dummy?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
This is the part where you tell me what
kinda
training I should do for the Oka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're such a carrot-head! Now that
you've
ranked up as a familiar, you
should be able to
read your master's
thoughts!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When I tell you what I wanna do, you're
supposed
to be two steps ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Got that, Familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Start thinking, then. What kind of
training should
I do for the Oka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Sweep Tosho, I move to
stand next
to her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And it's your job to deal with all the
adults who
try and talk to me before
races!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And you need to have some tasty juice
ready for
me in the waiting room! And...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second I stand next to her, she
starts barking
one order after another
for her "familiar."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the first race my demanding master
and I will
be attempting in the new year
is the Oka Sho.
